sources.title: slm-125m — a 125.8M-parameter model trained from scratch
sources.snippet: A 125.8M-parameter LLaMA-architecture language model trained from scratch on US case law, SEC filings, and the open web. Live inference demo, full architecture and training specs.

sources.title: legal-slm-125 · a 125M legal & financial language model
sources.snippet: Fine-tuned on 5,846 grounded legal & financial Q&A pairs, the same 125M model stops rambling and starts answering. It is a separate model, legal-slm-125m-sft ↗, that streams its reply as you watch.

sources.title: SLM-125M · a legal language model trained from scratch
sources.snippet: A 125-million-parameter Llama-style language model, pretrained from random weights on a legal and financial corpus. Give it the start of a sentence and it continues in the legal register.
